source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo uses stripe-node 22.1.1 (pnpm-lock.yaml) with an explicit acacia apiVersion pin in api/webhook.ts. stripe-node 23.0.0 pins 2026-09-30.endive and removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, the ErrorType export and V2List V1-only fields. The repo calls constructEvent, not the removed function, but the agent should grep for ErrorType imports. The concrete break on upgrade is payment_method_types in checkout.sessions.create (api/create-checkout.ts:55), which Endive removes for Checkout Sessions.

Uncertain points for the migration agent to check:
- Whether create-checkout.ts builds its own Stripe client without an apiVersion. If so, it inherits the SDK default and switches to endive as soon as the package is bumped.
- Whether the acacia pin type-checks against v23's literal apiVersion type.

Intermediate versions (basil/clover/dahlia) are crossed by the pin move. Nothing breaks until the repo upgrades, so urgency is medium, tied to the Endive release date.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23.0.0 pins 2026-09-30.endive. Upgrading the SDK and moving the explicit apiVersion pin in api/webhook.ts:23 (currently 2025-02-24.acacia) to endive is the same move. Endive's breaking changes that touch this repo are handled in this PR.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. api/create-checkout.ts:55 passes payment_method_types to checkout.sessions.create. This only fails once requests go out on 2026-09-30.endive, which is what the stripe-node 23 upgrade does. Dropping the parameter (and relying on dynamic payment methods from the Dashboard) is part of this upgrade's edit.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. The repo pins 2025-02-24.acacia, so moving the pin to endive also crosses the Dahlia breaking changes. None of the Dahlia items (ui_mode enum, events_from, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js removals) appear in the recorded call sites. The migration agent should still review them as part of the same version jump rather than in a separate PR.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"

callSites.why: checkout.sessions.create passes payment_method_types, which Endive removes. Remove the parameter when the request version moves to endive (via the SDK 23 default or an updated pin).

Explicit apiVersion pin 2025-02-24.acacia. This pin should be updated to 2026-09-30.endive, the version stripe-node 23 types expect. Updating it also changes the shape of webhook event payloads parsed by constructEvent.

webhooks.constructEvent is kept in v23; only constructEventWithoutVerification was removed. Verify that no code uses the removed ErrorType export and that the handlers reading event objects still match Endive payload shapes.

record.prBody:
## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Needs review]

### Change

Bumped stripe to 23.0.0 via pnpm. Both API files now pin 2026-09-30.endive (webhook was acacia; create-checkout was 2023-10-16). Removed payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create. No use of constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType, or V2List. No current_period_end/invoice.subscription/ui_mode usage was found, so the Dahlia/Basil items don't apply. Added tests/unit/stripe-endive.test.ts.

Files touched:
- `api/create-checkout.ts`
- `api/webhook.ts`
- `package.json`
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`
- `tests/unit/stripe-endive.test.ts`

### Why

v23 types accept only the endive apiVersion, and Endive removes payment_method_types from Checkout Sessions.

> Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| test | pass | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- stripe__stripe_check_params: pass (POST /v1/checkout/sessions at 2026-09-30.endive: no problems)

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `corepack pnpm@10.34.3 run build:core` (Server, vue and react packages import @smallwebco/tinypivot-core via its dist output, which is only produced by building it. Type-check (server's tsc --noEmit) and tests need core's dist/index.d.ts to exist.); it exited 0.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- The proof test is a source/package check, not a behavioral test
- Endive response shapes for the webhook's checkout.session.completed handling not verified live
- Test was run as part of the repo test suite, not registered separately via run_checks add
- The agent wrote no test of this change and gave no reason why none can be written.

### Behaviour changes

- Checkout now uses dynamic payment methods from the Dashboard instead of card only, so customers may see different payment methods
- create-checkout moves from API 2023-10-16 to endive
- Dashboard webhook endpoint API version should be aligned to endive
- stripe 23 requires Node >=20; confirm deploy runtime

---

Only core needs a prior build; the other packages are built by the build check itself. No env vars are needed because the .env.example values are only for the example demo's runtime server.

review.summary: The removed API (`Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification`) is not used anywhere. `webhook.ts:323` still calls `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent`, so the forced part of this migration is just the SDK bump and the apiVersion pin. The diff also makes an unforced behaviour change: it drops `payment_method_types: ['card']` from checkout session creation. Combined with a webhook that issues licenses on `checkout.session.completed` without checking `payment_status`, this could hand out licenses for payments that have not settled yet. The new test only greps source strings, so nothing exercises a live Checkout or webhook flow. needs-review is the right grade.

concerns.issue: Removing `payment_method_types: ['card']` (old line 57) is not required by the quoted changelog entry. Without it, Checkout falls back to dynamic payment methods from the Dashboard, which may include delayed-notification methods such as bank debits or vouchers. For those, `checkout.session.completed` fires with `payment_status: 'unpaid'`. `api/webhook.ts` generates and emails a perpetual license on `checkout.session.completed` without checking `session.payment_status`, so this change could issue licenses before (or without) payment. Either restore the param or add a `payment_status === 'paid'` check plus handling for `checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded`.

The apiVersion jumps from '2023-10-16' to '2026-09-30.endive', crossing several dated API versions (acacia, basil, clover, …), each with its own breaking request and response changes. Typecheck passing only shows the SDK's types accept the literal. I could not confirm the endive changes from memory; check the Stripe API upgrade guide and the 23.0.0 changelog for any Checkout Session changes to `mode: 'payment'`, `line_items`, `metadata` and `url`.

The webhook payload shape is set by the API version on the Dashboard webhook endpoint, not by the SDK `apiVersion`. The code now types `event` and `session` against endive shapes while the endpoint may still send an older version. The fields actually used (`metadata.plan`, `customer_details.email`) are probably stable, but the types prove nothing about the live payload.
stripe 23.0.0 requires node >=20 (see the lockfile `engines`), but the root `engines.node` is still '>=18'. Confirm the Vercel functions runtime is Node 20 or newer, and consider updating `engines`.

The tests only grep source files and read `node_modules/stripe/package.json`. They do not exercise `checkout.sessions.create` or `constructEvent`, so signature verification and session creation under the new SDK and API version are untested. Reading `node_modules` also makes the test environment-dependent.

checkFirst: Decide whether dropping `payment_method_types: ['card']` is intended. If it is, add a `payment_status === 'paid'` check in `api/webhook.ts` before generating a license.
Check which payment methods are enabled in the Stripe Dashboard for this account; it is shared with other products, according to the webhook comment.
Confirm the webhook endpoint's API version in the Dashboard and run `stripe trigger checkout.session.completed` against a deployment that verifies signatures.
Confirm the Vercel function runtime is Node 20 or newer.
Review the Stripe API changelog between 2023-10-16 and 2026-09-30.endive for Checkout Session changes.
